claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic is primarily broadcast in the U.S. on the FOX family of networks (FOX, FS1, FS2) and FOX Deportes.
Live streaming options for the 2026 World Baseball Classic include the FOX Sports app.
Live streaming options for the 2026 World Baseball Classic include FOXSports.com.
Live streaming options for the 2026 World Baseball Classic include FOX One.
Live streaming options for the 2026 World Baseball Classic include Tubi.
Live streaming options for the 2026 World Baseball Classic include Fubo.
Live streaming options for the 2026 World Baseball Classic include DIRECTV.
FOX Deportes provides Spanish coverage of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
The semifinals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are on FS1 on March 15-16 at 8 p.m. ET.
The championship of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is on FOX on March 17 at 8 p.m. ET.
Sportsnet provides coverage of the 2026 World Baseball Classic in Canada in English.
TVA Sports provides coverage of the 2026 World Baseball Classic in Canada in French.
WAPA Deportes provides coverage of the 2026 World Baseball Classic in Puerto Rico.
Netflix Japan provides coverage of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
